sources.name: ArchDaily
sources.summary: The Fundació Mies van der Rohe launches the call for the 5th Lilly Reich Grant for Equality in Architecture with the aim of continuing to generate research and debate on modern and contemporary architecture. This is done in dialogue with current paradigm shifts, paying special attention to diversity, inclusion, and the different dimensions of sustainability. On the occasion of this 5th edition, special attention will be given to research proposals related to the figure, work, legacy, and professional context of Lilly Reich.
